..Title
Resolution to Approve Schedule 34 to the Interagency Agreement for Collaborative Technology and Services with Washtenaw County for the Enterprise Content Management System ($328,907.53 over a 5-Year Period)
..Memorandum
Attached for your review and approval is a resolution authorizing the approval of Schedule 34 to the Interagency Agreement for Collaborative Technology and Services for a five-year commitment to utilize the shared Electronic Content Management System (ECM). 

This Schedule allows for collaboration and cost sharing and eliminates the need and cost for two separate ECM platforms. The City of Ann Arbor will pay Washtenaw County for 50% of shared services maintenance, and pay full-cost maintenance on licensing for City users. 

City Council approved participation in the Interagency Agreement for Collaborative Technology and Services in 2011 (R-11-180).  Renewals of the Original Agreement were approved by City Council in 2013 (R-13-037), 2016 (R-16-243), and 2020 (R-20-089). 

The City will be invoiced each calendar year (2026 through 2030) in the amount of $57,201.31.  A 15% contingency in the amount of $42,900.98 is requested to be made available for any additional costs due to the purchase of additional shared services or licenses.

Budget/Fiscal Impact:  The City's portion of ECM is planned and budgeted for in the Information Technology Services Budget
..Staff
Prepared by:	Kevin Eyer, Technology and Change Manager, Information Technology
Reviewed by: 	Joshua Baron, Director, Information Technology
Reviewed by: 	Kim Hoenerhoff, Financial Analyst
Approved by: 	Milton Dohoney Jr, City Administrator
..Body
Whereas, Washtenaw County and the City of Ann Arbor entered into an Interagency Agreement for Collaborative Technology and Services;

Whereas, The City will pay for 50% of shared ECM services maintenance and pay full-cost maintenance on licensing for City users and these costs are budgeted for in the FY26 and FY27 Information Technology Services Budget and are planned to be budgeted therein in future years; and

Whereas; This resolution authorizes the City to pay Washtenaw County for utilization of the Electronic Content Management System (ECM);

RESOLVED, That City Council approve the attached Schedule 34 of the Interagency Agreement for Collaborative Technology and Services with Washtenaw County as the provider and the City of Ann Arbor as subscriber for the Electronic Content Management System for five years;

RESOLVED, That the Mayor and City Clerk be authorized and directed to execute the Schedule 34 Interagency Agreement for Collaborative Technology and Services after approval as to substance by the City Administrator and approval as to form by the City Attorney; 

RESOLVED, That the City Council approve a fifteen percent (15%) contingency in the amount of $42,900.98 to be expendable from the Information Technology Services Budget, subject to City Administrator approval; and

RESOLVED, That the City Administrator be authorized to take all necessary actions to implement this Resolution, including execution of any amendments and renewals that do not exceed the amounts authorized herein, regardless of Fiscal Year, and termination of the Agreement on its terms as deemed necessary.
